report:
Reviewed the complete canonical_sources claim and the sole ordinary implementation association sage_meta::spec (spec.rs), all three ordinary tests and the explicit TODO test. Requirements are equal-authority Markdown/Sage definitions; preserved text and source location; Sage declaration/method/envelope ownership; bidirectional references without new definitions; rejection of dangling references. load_workspace sends both normative forms through add_chapter_text; parse_anchors retains content/spans, Sage dedent offsets remap these to the original source, and model namespace plus prose owner supplies entity identity. References populate a separate collection and are resolved against the completed anchor map, so ordering and source form do not create extra definitions. Unknown targets produce diagnostics. The existing ownership integration demonstrates declaration, field and query identities; exhaustive ownership/context scenarios remain part of explicit integration-test deferral, not a claim of exhaustive exercised coverage.

The sage_prose_rules_have_precise_spans_model_owners_and_cross_source_references test visibly asserts preserved Unicode/multiblock text, exact original marker/content spans, field/query ownership, context URL, two cross-origin references and their original source spans. nonnormative_book_chapters_reference_rules_without_defining_them asserts exactly one definition and two references, successful link rendering and an error after changing a reference to a missing target. reference_roles_validate_targets_but_ignore_code_examples asserts one genuine reference and precisely the dangling/malformed diagnostics, excluding examples. Captured BookFixture setup/load confirms real workspace loading rather than synthetic assertions.

definitions_across_markdown_and_sage remains an explicit TODO for the combined both-origin/duplicate/reference/context/chapter-naming matrix. Its prerequisite is writing those additional integration fixtures and assertions; its empty body supplies no executed behavioral evidence. Existing meaningful ordinary tests need not be replaced or weakened. This accepted deferred coverage remains visible, including broader ownership/context scenarios; no new implementation completion is inferred from the TODO.

Verified historical baseline directly: spec.rs and spec_plan.rs are exact byte matches. The only spec.rs test-file delta replaces the old review input claim field with selection of the matching Claim fragment and joins its contents; the same complete expected text remains. Independently reassessed current assertions and implementation rather than adopting the historical verdict. Additional dependencies were captured with review read. Commands personally executed were review start/read, source inspection and exact-byte/diff comparison, followed by review record; no behavioral tests/build were run by this reviewer. Coordinator-reported 321 passing functional tests and root build are separate execution evidence. No source edits requested.
